summary: LoftyInc Capital backs early-stage African entrepreneurs building tech-enabled solutions for what it calls the everyday economy, and announced a $43,000,000 first close of a new pan-African seed fund. Its Learn and Apply page describes criteria such as massive markets, defensible revenues and replicable growth models, and the site links a Submit Deck form. Portfolio highlights on the homepage include Flutterwave. Check size, formal stage definition and a street address are not stated on the pages reviewed.

investmentEvidence.fact: Featured on the homepage as a portfolio company founded in 2016. LoftyInc’s round and date are not stated.

sources.title: Homepage: African early-stage focus, seed fund announcement, portfolio and Submit Deck link
